title: Vanadium first discovered in Mexico
summary: Working at the College of Mines in New Spain, Andrés Manuel del Río discovered compounds of a new element in 1801 and proposed the name panchromium, later erythronium.
why: A new element, found in Mexico three decades before Europe named it.

unsung.contribution: Discovered the element now called vanadium.
unsung.recognition: His discovery was not credited at the time; Nils Sefström of Sweden rediscovered and named it in 1830.
